name: Zombie Master
description: A controller of zombies, said to have commanded them before his own death and now one of them.

description_citations.text: Fourth Edition: card flavor text (Fourth Edition, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Zombie Master, said to have controlled zombies in life, becomes one of them in death.
timeline.quote: now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him
